name: Influx Query (read-only)
Solar Consumer Cascade
info: InfluxDB is read-only. Outputs 1-3 are the relay states of C1/C2/C3 as Boolean msg.payload (true=ON, false=OFF). Output 4 is the diagnostic debug_calc. The Flux query and server configuration are documented in node_red/node-red-contrib-solar-consumer/README.md. Set the InfluxDB token and organization in the Node-RED UI; credentials are stored in the Node-RED volume.
